# Harness mark sources

The Groups-tab harness indicators embed these product silhouettes in
`js/harness-mark.js`. The dashboard applies its own monochrome color and size;
the SVG geometry comes from the sources below.

- **Claude Code:** `claudecode.svg` from `@lobehub/icons-static-svg` 1.94.0.
  LobeHub Icons is MIT licensed; see `LICENSE-LobeHub.txt`.
  Source: https://unpkg.com/@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.94.0/icons/claudecode.svg
- **Codex:** OpenAI's 2025 Blossom symbol. The geometry is the public-domain
  simple-shape rendering published by Wikimedia Commons and attributed there
  to OpenAI. The OpenAI mark remains a trademark and is used only to identify
  the Codex harness.
  Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:OpenAI_logo_2025_(symbol).svg
- **GitHub Copilot CLI:** GitHub Copilot mark distributed by Simple Icons,
  whose per-icon metadata identifies the upstream Primer icon and its MIT
  license. See `LICENSE-GitHub-Primer.txt`.
  Source: https://primer.style/foundations/icons/copilot-24
- **OpenCode:** OpenCode's own `packages/identity/mark.svg`. OpenCode is MIT
  licensed; see `LICENSE-OpenCode.txt`.
  Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/1251a870cb384543c150c4a72fb101b55eec971b/packages/identity/mark.svg

Product names and logos may be trademarks of their respective owners. Their
appearance identifies the selected external harness and does not imply
endorsement of tclaude.
